summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K announcing the purchase of 449,197 ordinary shares (5 pence each) from JP Morgan Securities plc in an on-exchange transaction pursuant to a previously announced arrangement. The shares were bought at an average price of 11.2415 GBP per share (range: 11.18–11.38 GBP) and will be cancelled. After cancellation, total shares outstanding will be 2,521,670,925. The buyback is authorized by the 2025 AGM and complies with UK Listing Rules and Hong Kong Code on Share Buy-Backs. This is an ordinary-course capital return via open-market repurchases; no premium, premium date, or advisory involvement is stated. Watch for continued share cancellation and impact on shareholder voting thresholds.
